description: Returns a browser link to checkout for the requested Pro or Dreamer plan and optional billing interval or promo code. Sign-in precedes checkout when required. No charge occurs until payment is confirmed on the checkout page.

billingInterval.description: Only when the person named one. Quarterly is one invoice every three months at about 15% less; a promo code prices a monthly invoice, so the two cannot be combined.

plan.description: The plan the person asked for.

promoCode.description: Only when the person supplied one.

name: get_upgrade_link
title: Get a link to upgrade
